verdict.rationale: Brave documents a dedicated LLM Context endpoint built for machine consumption. It returns pre-extracted, token-budgeted page content as the default for RAG, and token and URL limits are configurable to size the context. Extra snippets and Goggles custom re-ranking add more context and ranking control, though AI-inference use requires the separate AI plan rather than the free tier. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the RAG-ready output and the vendor's benchmark claim, and detailed documentation of how results are ranked specifically for LLM relevance.
